cost.rate: Declared DeepSeek Flash off-peak input/output tariff; estimate, not invoiced spend

pricing.basis: Submission estimate at the declared DeepSeek Flash off-peak rates for every logged call. Not an actual invoice. Saved ledgers retain the historical requested model name; upstream model identity was not independently verified.
pricing.assumptions: Use off-peak rates for the entire estimate, regardless of call time. Cached-input counts were not recorded, so input is priced as cache miss. Failed calls with no returned usage cannot establish whether the provider billed anything.

receipts.coverage: Partial billing snapshots only; complete actual project spend is not known.

coverage.baseline_note: before the extension the case-study profiles had none of these fields (industry_code was in the core ontology but no approved config mapped it)

financial_corruption.finding: every financial fact has exactly one source (the ATO); a corrupted value would win unopposed. Corroboration needs a second financial source (e.g. ACNC AIS revenue).
